run_pipeline_simulation: run a multi-stage pipeline simulation with configurable stage processing times and concurrency levels
build_pipeline: build a pipeline with configurable stages, concurrency, and aggregation using PipelineBuilder
parse_stage_configs: parse a stage configuration string into tuples of sleep duration, concurrency, and batch size
create_simulated_stage: create a SimulatedStage callable that processes items with configurable sleep duration and random jitter
run_configuration: run a pipeline configuration for a set duration and save performance statistics to SQLite
